raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / TRILOCALE CON PISCINA: STILE E RELAX AL LIDO DI JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Trilocale con Piscina: stile e relax al Lido di Jesolo PIAZZA NEMBER · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €340,000 Photos (15) Floor plans (0) 1 / 15 FLOOR AREA 75 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A1 Overview Welcome to your new home at Wave Resort, an oasis of style, comfort, and pure atmosphere in Jesolo Lido. Located in the renowned Piazza Nember area, this first-floor apartment represents the perfect mix of daily convenience and the pleasure of living with a perpetual vacation feel. Crossing the threshold, the property welcomes you into a bright open-plan living area designed to capture natural light throughout the day. The kitchenette harmoniously integrates with the living room, creating a warm and inviting space. The real highlight of the living area is the wonderful habitable terrace: a private outdoor space that directly overlooks the heated swimming pool of the residence. The sleeping area includes a spacious master bedroom alongside a versatile second bedroom, ideal for accommodating family or friends or converting into an office. Servicing the apartment is a windowed bathroom equipped with a comfortable shower box. Living at Wave Resort means choosing maximum comfort and relaxation every single day. The property also features a private parking spot on the ground floor—a crucial detail for this area. The location is perfect: just 400 meters from the beach, easily reachable via pleasant walks. Proximity to restaurants, boutiques, and all services in Piazza Nember allows you to forget about your car and enjoy freedom while remaining immersed in tranquility within meticulously maintained residence security details.
